title: Inspecting a Wrapped Error
description: Pull structured detail out of a wrapped error chain with errors.AsType, and use errors.Is for the sentinel, so each question is asked with the right tool.
short_description: Ask an error what it is, in one line
learning_objectives: Use errors.AsType to find a typed error anywhere in a chain
Choose between errors.Is and errors.AsType deliberately
Remember that wrapping means a type assertion is not enough
real_world_connection: Any handler that maps internal errors to HTTP status codes does this: is it a validation problem, a rate limit, or a missing record, and what were the details.
requirements: FailedField and RetryAfter look through the whole chain
Both report false when there is no match, including for a nil error
Classify names validation, ratelimit, notfound or unknown
The sentinel is matched with errors.Is, not by type
bonus_points: Rewrite one of them with errors.As and compare the line count and the scope of the variable
Add a second ValidationError deeper in the chain and confirm the outermost match wins
